cohort: Pregnant women with mechanical heart valves (MHV) on anticoagulation at the Yale-New Haven Hospital from 2007 to 2018
finding: Pregnant women with MHV were at increased risk for postpartum hemorrhagic complications, and there was significant variability in the timing of restarting postpartum anticoagulation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 64% of the pregnancies.
